newsitem.title: ITALY: IBM open to services link with Olivetti-press.
newsitem.headline: IBM open to services link with Olivetti-press.

text.p: IBM is open to possible alliances in value-added sectors like systems and services but is not interested in Olivetti's troubled PC business, IBM Semea managing director Tomaso Quattrin was quoted as saying.
The official of IBM's Southern Europe, Middle East and Africa division was speaking in an interview with Milan financial weekly Il Mondo which released extracts ahead of publication on Saturday.
"We could discuss this with Olivetti's Systems and Services division," Quattrin said. But he reaffirmed that "IBM is not interested in (Olivetti) personal computers."

Chairman of IBM Europe Lucio Stanca told reporters at an international conference in Cernobbio, Italy, last week that the U.S. computer giant is not currently interested in Olivetti's loss-making PC business.

Quattrin was quoted as saying he opposed the possibility of the Italian state coming to Olivetti's rescue, a move the government has denied is likely and even Olivetti has said it is not seeking state backing.
"This would be a grave mistake, damaging for the IT sector and for the image of Italy," he told Il Mondo.
